subject: Re: Aurora Financial — CAIQ control lineage clarifications & evidence bundle
messages:
From: Laurel Briggs <laurel.briggs@aurorafin.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@aurorafin.com
Date: 2028-06-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Aurora CAIQ — clarifications and control lineage request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. We’re preparing our vendor assurance packet for the board review and noticed a few CAIQ items where we need more color and sample artifacts from Redwood:

- SC-08 / Logging retention: we need a short statement on retention policy for inference runtime logs and a sample log export showing tenant id/redaction.
- CRS-04 / Tenant separation: a brief control narrative describing KV cache and prefix isolation across tenants plus any isolation diagrams.
- RTI-02 / Telemetry lineage: an account of how telemetry enters your pipeline and an example trace for an inference request (no PII, redacted).
- Evidence packaging: preferred format for delivering artifacts (spreadsheet crosswalk + ZIP), and if there’s an S3/Drive upload link.

Can you get back to us with an annotated CAIQ crosswalk and a short evidence bundle by next Wednesday (2028-06-16)? If you need to loop any owners, please do so.

Appreciate it,
Laurel Briggs
Head of Vendor Risk
Aurora Financial

Attachments requested: CAIQ template (they attached a template to their initial request).

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laurel Briggs <laurel.briggs@aurorafin.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T10:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Aurora CAIQ — clarifications and control lineage request

Laurel — thanks for the clear ask. Looped in the owners below and proposed deliverables.

Action plan (owners):
- Kimberly Park: prepare logging retention statement + sample log extract (redacted) — Deliverable: runtime-telemetry-sample.log
- Marissa Cole: CAIQ narrative edits for tenant isolation and assertion language — Deliverable: annotated CAIQ spreadsheet
- Priyom Das: control lineage diagram and packaging (ZIP of artifacts) + upload to shared drive — Deliverable: control-lineage-diagram.png, evidence-bundle.zip

We’ll assemble an "Annotated CAIQ + Evidence Bundle" and upload to a secured folder by EOD Tuesday (2028-06-15) to give you a day to review before your board deadline.

Kimberly/Marissa/Priyom — please treat this as priority; Laurel asked for a concise narrative per control and one representative artifact per assertion. If a control requires a longer artifact we’ll include an index entry in the spreadsheet.

Jonas Weber
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laurel Briggs <laurel.briggs@aurorafin.com>
Date: 2028-06-09T14:36:00Z
Subject: Re: Aurora CAIQ — logging retention sample

Jonas / Laurel / team — attaching the log sample stub and a short retention statement. This log is synthetic and redacted to remove any identifying tokens.

Retention statement (summary): Redwood Inference stores inference routing and telemetry logs in an encrypted S3 bucket for 90 days by default for hosted tenants; customers on Dedicated can configure retention down to 7 days or up to 365 days by contract. Logs containing potential PII are redacted at ingestion via the redaction pipeline (see control description in the annotated CAIQ). Access to log buckets is restricted to the Platform Operations role via IAM policy.

Attached: runtime-telemetry-sample.log (stub) — shows timestamp, request_id, tenant_hash (not raw tenant id), and event type.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Compliance Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: runtime-telemetry-sample.log (text stub)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laurel Briggs <laurel.briggs@aurorafin.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T11:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Aurora CAIQ — annotated crosswalk and package upload

Team / Laurel — uploaded the annotated crosswalk and the evidence bundle to the secure share: https://redwood-internal-drive.company/aurora/caiq-annotated-v1 (link expires in 14 days).

What I uploaded:
- CAIQ-Annotated-Crosswalk.xlsx — worksheet includes: control id, our assertion text, evidence filename, owner, and notes column for sampling guidance.
- control-lineage-diagram.png — high-level diagram showing inference request flow, KV cache isolation, and where telemetry is captured.
- evidence-bundle.zip — contains one representative artifact per assertion (policy PDFs, IAM policy snippets, log extract).

Notes for Aurora: we marked controls that are environment-specific (Hosted vs Dedicated) and included a small "sampling guidance" column indicating which artifacts are live evidence vs implementation notes.

If you’d like us to export a flattened index (CSV) for ingestion into your GRC tool let me know and we’ll produce it by EOD.

— Priyom
Controls Analyst — Redwood Inference

Attachments: CAIQ-Annotated-Crosswalk.xlsx, control-lineage-diagram.png, evidence-bundle.zip

From: Laurel Briggs <laurel.briggs@aurorafin.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T15:26:00Z
Subject: Re: Aurora CAIQ — annotated crosswalk and package upload

Team — received the upload and bundle, thanks for the quick turnaround. The annotated spreadsheet is very helpful and the diagram clarifies the KV isolation behavior.

A couple of quick follow-ups:
- Can you include the exact IAM policy snippet that gates S3 access for the log buckets?
- One of our auditors asked whether the KV cache is ever shared in a multi-tenant runtime in burst scenarios — can you add a single line in the tenant isolation note confirming that caches are namespaced per-tenant and never shared across tenant namespaces?

We’d prefer a 20-minute call tomorrow morning to confirm these two small items before we finalize our packet. Are you available 2028-06-11 09:00-09:30 PT?

Thanks again — Laurel
Head of Vendor Risk
Aurora Financial
